items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

ctx.x: Well Community — Columbia Artists came to a concert I did in 1992 up at the Emelin Theater up in Westchester. I invited them because I knew that they have probably five or six hundred venues throughout the United States, an organization called Community Concerts. And what they do is, it started out as a classical Columbia Records or Columbia Recordings started it many years ago, 75 or 80 years ago, as an outlet for their artists and what they did was a small community would get up a budget let’s say of $30,000…
